//: Moving the camp. A station listed in fixed is masonry or dug in and cannot be packed. Ordinary abandoned houses may be adapted as a base; special sites, story places, the village, water and roads remain unavailable.
//firstShelter: A new run has no camp. On any hex of the listed terrains with no camp standing anywhere, the survivor may build this shelter; the camp is made on that hex when it is finished, not when it is begun (game src/game/home/Home.js startFirstShelter; its site remembers its hex).
//siteMinutes: A station that takes this long or longer is built as a site (run.home.site): its materials go in when the work starts, and the work done is kept when it is interrupted, cancelled or the survivor walks away; it is resumed ("Keep building") or abandoned with its materials back. 0: every build, the first hour-long hut included (decided 26.09.2026). Only one site stands at a time.
//startSpawns: What the ground you wake on is sure to hold besides its own, [interactable, count]: enough for the first shelter (the simple wooden hut) within the first hour or two.
